entry.name: AstraMilitarum/ScholaDescription
entry.value: Building that produces Cadets.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/ScholaFlavor
entry.value: The Schola is one of the many divisions of the Astra Militarum It is responsible for the upbringing, education and training of students, producing Cadets, as future Officers for Imperial Service if they survive.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/AircraftDescription
entry.value: Building that produces aircraft as well as generates ore and influence.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/AircraftFlavor
entry.value: This landing field was designed for larger craft—almost up to the intra-system scale—but with the endless warpstorms, it's been repurposed to house the Imperial air forces. Much like a Skyshield landing pad, it has limited field generators to protect grounded aircraft from incoming fire.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Construction
entry.value: Labour Corps

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/ConstructionDescription
entry.value: Building that constructs new buildings as well as generates food and minerals.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/ConstructionFlavor
entry.value: Whilst the Administratum runs the entire Empire of man, the Departmento Munitorum is tasked solely with supplying the manpower and supplies for the Astra Militarum. Among their many tasks is the construction of large facilities, such as airfields or orbital stations. The poor grunts who have to do the work are the Labour Corps, indentured or penal workers and mind-wiped servitors.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Logistica
entry.value: Logistica Corps

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/LogisticaDescription
entry.value: Building that constructs new Huge scale buildings.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/LogisticaFlavor
entry.value: Whilst the Administratum runs the entire Empire of man, the Logistica is tasked with supplying the manpower and supplies for the Administratums large scle projects. Among their many tasks is the construction of plantary scale facilities. These Places make even the titans pale in scale.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Energy
entry.value: Plasma Ioniser

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/EnergyDescription
entry.value: Building that generates energy.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/EnergyFlavor
entry.value: Whilst the ancients may have split the atom, the Empire's Techpriests have had millennia to perfect the rituals by which they draw up power. The open-core Plasma Ioniser uses coolant-infusion systems to maintain an output of around 100 petawatts for up to a hundred days at a time—around 10,000 times that of the largest historical fission plant.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Food
entry.value: Soylens Farm

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/FoodDescription
entry.value: Building that harvests food.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/FoodFlavor
entry.value: Soylens viridians might be filling, nutritious and easy to grow in great vats—but as a foodstuff it has some drawbacks. First, it's utterly bland and flavourless. Second, it looks like green gloop. Third, it's made from any available organic matter. Persistent rumour has it that human corpses are not excluded.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Food2
entry.value: Vat Farms

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Food2Description
entry.value: Huge Buildings that harvest food.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Food2Flavor
entry.value: Hydroponic farm vats stand as vital installations supporting the sustenance of humanity across vast, desolate planets. These high-tech vats utilize advanced hydroponic and nutrient delivery systems to cultivate essential crops in controlled environments, circumventing the harsh conditions of barren worlds. Imperatively linked to the survival of isolated colonies and war-torn outposts, hydroponic vats exemplify the Imperium's relentless pursuit of resource optimization amidst the ceaseless turmoil of interstellar warfare. Amidst the echoes of battle, these vats symbolize the fragile thread that connects humanity to sustenance in the face of relentless adversity.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Loyalty
entry.value: Sanctum Imperialis

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/LoyaltyDescription
entry.value: Building that increases loyalty.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/LoyaltyFlavor
entry.value: The local seat of the Imperial Cult may appear dark and gothic, but is in fact a hallowed place. Adorned by statues of saints, it is a venerated local symbol of the Emperor's godlike will, and provides inspiration to the nearby populace.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Headquarters
entry.value: Basilica Administratum

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/HeadquartersDescription
entry.value: Headquarters building that generates resources.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/HeadquartersFlavor
entry.value: The central administrative building of any Imperial colony, the magnificent Basilica is a temple to bureaucracy. Generations of plain-clad clerks live and die amidst tottering tomes, deciding the fate of star systems with the feeble thump of their stamps. As the saying goes, the Inquisition may burn you, the Astartes smite you—but only the Adeptus Administratum can torment you for your entire life.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Heroes
entry.value: Shrine of the Aquila

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/HeroesDescription
entry.value: Building that produces heroes as well as generates influence and increases loyalty.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/HeroesFlavor
entry.value: Far more than a mere statue, this great metal eagle was cast from the molten remains of space-faring vessels, and serves as an inspiration for those nearby. The Imperial troops that fight under the Aquila's ceaseless vigil find a new determination welling in their hearts, knowing that they are the last in a line of heroes that stretches across the stars.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Housing
entry.value: Hab Block

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/HousingDescription
entry.value: Building that increases population limit.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/HousingFlavor
entry.value: The classic Imperial structure, these identikit city buildings are seen all over the Empire. They provide the minimum amount of shelter and comfort required for the people of the Imperium to eke out their short lives. At a colony's founding, sometimes they're built in situ—but more often, on remote planets, they're dropped directly from any colonising spaceships.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Infantry
entry.value: Imperial Barracks

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/InfantryDescription
entry.value: Building that produces infantry as well as increases population limit and loyalty.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/InfantryFlavor
entry.value: Whilst the training of recruits to the Imperial Guard has none of the harrowing horrors suffered by Astartes initiates, the Munitorum still has to drill the strictures of the Empire into the tithed men and women that make up most Guard regiments. Here, at the Barracks, a planet's unpromising conscripts are turned into the true Astra Militarum—by giving them uniforms, guns and perhaps even some training.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Bastion
entry.value: Solar Auxilia Bastion

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/BastionDescription
entry.value: Huge Building that produces infantry.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/BastionFlavor
entry.value: The Solar Auxilia Bastion, recruits Militarum soldiers in bulk. Renowned for discipline and advanced weaponry, they serve as auxiliaries, undergoing rigorous training to uphold unwavering loyalty in the Imperium's relentless battles. huge training halls and mass housing allows for training huge nubmer of troops.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Influence
entry.value: Cogitator Station

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/InfluenceDescription
entry.value: Building that generates influence.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/InfluenceFlavor
entry.value: Though artificial intelligence is an abomination, long abhorred since the fall of the Men of Iron, the archaic data looms of the Adeptus Administratum bear little resemblance to ancient computers or even to the slim microprocessors used by the Techpriests of Mars. Cogitators functions are purely bureaucratic, their form immobile. Still, their capabilities are prized by every Imperial world purely for their inhuman memory.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Ore
entry.value: Ore Extractor

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/OreDescription
entry.value: Building that harvests ore.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/OreFlavor
entry.value: Depending on the planet, extraction of metal ores and valuable minerals is undertaken by anything ranging from ancient-tech machinery barely controlled by its Techpriest magos to thousands of Labour Corp workers, playing their part in the war to save mankind.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Ore2
entry.value: Extraction Pit

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Ore2Description
entry.value: Huge Building that harvests ore.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Ore2Flavor
entry.value: Adeptus Mechanicus-led operations employ colossal machines and slave labor to strip planets of resources for the Imperium's ceaseless war machine. Planetary ecosystems suffer, populations are sacrificed, and landscapes bear the scars of relentless exploitation, all to fuel the galaxy's unending conflicts.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Psykers
entry.value: Psyker Coven

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/PsykersDescription
entry.value: Building that produces psykers as well as generates energy and influence.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/PsykersFlavor
entry.value: Whilst the warpstorm rages, the peacetime use of psykers—as astropaths, for long-range communication—is pointless. Similarly, without being able to reach the Black Ships, unwanted psykers can't be transported to Terra for sacrifice at the Golden Throne. Instead, most are executed, with a select few drafted into Imperial service as Sanctioned Psykers.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Research
entry.value: Officio Tactica

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/ResearchDescription
entry.value: Building that generates research.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/ResearchFlavor
entry.value: Learning to be an officer of the Astra Militarum is a thankless, often lethal task. One of the safest postings is to the Officio Tactica, where the smartest tactical minds analyse ongoing military manouevres and refer to the copious texts of the Tactica Imperialis for well-tested advice. They also record their current campaigns, so that future generations might learn from them.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Upgrades
entry.value: Cult Mechanicus

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/UpgradesDescription
entry.value: Building that produces Techpriest Enginseers and generates research.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/UpgradesFlavor
entry.value: The Techpriests worship of 'the Omnissiah', a machine-god, would surely be frowned upon, were it not for their usefulness. Instead, a tacit agreement is in place; the Techpriests acknowledge publicly that the Emperor was the Omnissiah and the Administratum agrees not to pry too closely.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/VehiclesDescription
entry.value: Building that produces ground vehicles as well as generates ore and research.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/VehiclesFlavor
entry.value: To call an Imperial Manufactorum a 'factory' is akin to calling a Catachan Devil an insect. These cyclopean structures are huge, forbidding temples to the Machine God, wherein his miracles—here vehicles of war—are created. Inside them, lowly menials are doomed to never see the planet's surface, as they ceaselessly minister to the blessed engines of Mars.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles1
entry.value: Sentinel Manufactorum

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles1Description
entry.value: Building that produces ground vehicles as well as generates ore and research.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles1Flavor
entry.value: A Scout Sentinel factory is a noisy and bustling industrial complex where skilled workers and automated machinery assembling these agile combat walkers. The atmosphere is filled with the smells of oil and welding. The process involves precise construction of the frame, integration of advanced technology, and mounting of various weapons. The factory showcases the Imperium's relentless commitment to military production in the grim dark of the 41st millennium.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles2
entry.value: Chimera Manufactorum

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles2Description
entry.value: Building that produces ground vehicles as well as generates ore and research.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles2Flavor
entry.value: The Chimera troop transport factory is a vast industrial complex where skilled workers and Tech-priests of the Adeptus Mechanicus assemble these versatile war machines. The air is thick with the scent of chemicals, and the sound of machinery fills the halls as assembly lines produce the Chimeras' robust chassis and complex machinery. Servitors and Tech-priests oversee the process, ensuring precision in construction. The factory echoes with the sounds of testing, creating a constant atmosphere of war. In the end, it serves as a crucial hub for the Imperium, producing the armored transports that will carry its soldiers into the relentless battles of the 41st millennium.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles3
entry.value: Hydra Manufactorum

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles3Description
entry.value: Building that produces ground vehicles as well as generates ore and research.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles3Flavor
entry.value: The Hydra anti-air tank factory in is a vast industrial complex where Tech-Priests and servitors work relentlessly on assembly lines. The atmosphere is grim and efficient, with a cacophony of machinery and the acrid scent of Burning metals and melting wire. Tech-Priests oversee production, adorned in red robes and bionic enhancements. The assembly lines feature servo-arms and mechadendrites, constructing Hydra tanks in various stages. The facility is adorned with the Adeptus Mechanicus symbol, and security is tight with augmented Skitarii guards.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles4
entry.value: Basilisk Manufactorum

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles4Description
entry.value: Building that produces ground vehicles as well as generates ore and research.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles4Flavor
entry.value: The Basilisk artillery tank is manufactured in immense Forge Worlds or Munitorum facilities. These colossal factories are characterized by a grim and efficient atmosphere, with vast assembly lines, skilled Adeptus Mechanicus workers, and the fusion of advanced technology and ancient rituals. The production process involves creating tank chassis, forging Earthshaker Cannons, and installing essential components. The environment is illuminated by flickering lumens, and security is tight. The constant production is driven by the Imperium's need for formidable firepower on the war-torn battlefields of the 41st millennium.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles5
entry.value: DevilDog Manufactorum

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles5Description
entry.value: Building that produces ground vehicles as well as generates ore and research.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles5Flavor
entry.value: The Devil Dog Flamer Tank factory is a massive, foreboding facility where Adeptus Mechanicus Tech-Priests oversee the construction of specialized tanks armed with flamethrowers. The assembly line combines religious reverence for machinery with advanced technology, featuring foundries, manufactorums, and sacred rites of machine consecration. The atmosphere is one of grim dedication, with the air thick with purpose as the Imperium's war machine is tirelessly crafted to defend against the horrors of the 41st millennium.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles6
entry.value: LemanRuss BattleTank Manufactorum

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles6Description
entry.value: Building that produces ground vehicles as well as generates ore and research.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles6Flavor
entry.value: The Leman Russ Battle Tank Factory is a massive industrial complex where Tech-Priests of the Adeptus Mechanicus oversee the production of Leman Russ tanks. The atmosphere is noisy and chaotic, with assembly lines, foundries, and skilled workers crafting the tank's chassis and complex systems. Tech-Priests perform sacred rituals to imbue the tanks with the Machine God's favor. Security is tight to prevent sabotage, and the factory embodies the Imperium's commitment to overwhelming firepower in the grim darkness of the 41st millennium.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles7
entry.value: Rogal Dorn BattleTank Manufactorum

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles7Description
entry.value: Building that produces ground vehicles as well as generates ore and research.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles7Flavor
entry.value: The manufactorum producing older pattern Rogal Dorn main battle tanks is a fortified and sprawling factory on strategically vital planets. Inside, a mix of ancient rituals and advanced technology is employed in the grim and gothic atmosphere. Skilled workers, Tech-Priests, and servitors labor on assembly lines, merging traditional craftsmanship with cutting-edge engineering. The labyrinthine manufactorum is both a production facility and fortress, with dimly lit chambers filled with the scent of oil and metal. The grim reality of the 40K universe is evident in the constant activity and formidable defenses that surround the tank production process.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles8
entry.value: Baneblade Manufactorum

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles8Description
entry.value: Building that produces ground vehicles as well as generates ore and research.

entry.name: AstraMilitarum/Vehicles8Flavor
entry.value: Vital Baneblade tanks are produced in massive, fortified manufactorums. Inside, skilled Adeptus Mechanicus oversee assembly lines, where workers in protective gear construct the tanks amidst the clang of metal and the scent of molten metal. The process involves precision crafting, weapon installation, and machine blessings. Security is tight, with guards against internal dissent and external sabotage. The manufactorum is a hive of industry and devotion, dedicated to supplying the Imperium with the formidable firepower of Baneblade tanks.
